# alpha

Prose that mentions - **P1** in the middle of a line.

- **A1** the first obligation
- **AB12** letters then digits
- **A1** the same id again
  - **A3** indented, so not an obligation
* **A4** a star bullet, so not an obligation
- **a5** lowercase, so not an obligation
- **A** letters alone, so not an obligation
- **6** digits alone, so not an obligation
-  **A7** two spaces after the dash, so not an obligation
- **A8**text right after the closing stars still counts
- **A9a** a letter after the digits, so not an obligation
- **A10** digits can run on
- **A11** the last line, with no newline after it
